notes.title: I Love Finding Critters - Cinco de Mayo Update
notes.content:
In this Cinco de Mayo update, enjoy 2 new beautiful hidden object scenes. Search for a variety of critters and objects while traveling through scenes inspired by [b]Hidalgo [/b]and [b]Jalisco, Mexico[/b]!

notes.title: I Love Finding Critters is COMING SOON!
notes.content:
The I Love Finding Animals series takes an exotic turn in the latest entry, [b]I Love Finding Critters![/b] 

In I Love Finding Critters, the new Hidden Object scenes and mini games come with a whole new set of friends. Unlike before though, these little guys are a whole lot weirder! From Betta fish to chameleons to even Axolotls, all our feisty new friends are dying to meet you!

I Love Finding Critters will launch on Steam with a 25% discount for a limited time only!

notes.title: First Time in Paris - Now Available!
notes.content:
Our newest hidden object game, [b]First Time in Paris[/b], is now out on Steam! Play through gorgeous hidden object scenes and minigames as you join amateur travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole on their trip to see the sights of Paris and save a historic hotel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41145315/ed69c31d8080664220dfd1852f5965e69f2cf02a.png[/img]

Make sure you check First Time in Paris while it's still on 25% sale!

notes.title: First Time in Paris
notes.content:
We’re launching a brand-new hidden object series: the First Time series! 

Our newest series will follow amateur travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole as they visit famous cities around the world. Our first game in the series, First Time in Paris, follows the pair as they try to save a historic Parisian hospital from going out of business. 

[previewyoutube=jXfiVn_Y1HA;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767150/First_Time_in_Paris/]First Time in Paris[/url] launches on Steam this February 2022. Make sure to add it to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767150/First_Time_in_Paris/
